doc.interviewee: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant

title: White followers of Papa Celestin's band
summary: A busload of young white fans followed Celestin everywhere, including Baton Rouge.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Well, there was a white group who followed Papa Celeste everywhere he went. He'd go to Baton Rouge. There would be a bus load there with them. I don't know where they were from. They were from Tulane or where. Don't you remember when he went out there for the concert? Oh, about 15 or 20, even more, following him, wherever he'd go. He'd go and really have him to go out there at this concert he was giving. And we saw that whole bus load of young white girls and boys. And they told me they followed him everywhere he went. They just liked his music.
